verdict.rationale: Xero's marketing says JAX, its AI finance partner, "reconciles your transactions for you" by categorizing and matching bank transactions, which covers the matching core of the story. Xero also offers an official MCP server and AI toolkit for agent access, but the documented MCP capabilities list contacts, chart of accounts and invoices, not reconciliation. Duplicate-bill flagging is the only exception detection shown, and it applies to bills rather than bank reconciliation. Missing for 10: evidence of exception flagging within reconciliation, month-end close preparation and a human-review handoff, agent/MCP access to reconciliation endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration of JAX's matching.
